transform.rule: Only literal domain arguments of supported WordPress translation calls; preserve every other byte.

compatibility.internal_names: Preserve canonical YOWCL_* and shared YOSWC_Role_Claims identities; never blanket rename symbols or stored keys.
compatibility.legacy_names: Explicit facade per legacy YOSWC_* class/constant, preserving callable signatures; no blind class_alias for different APIs.
compatibility.hooks: One-way post-commit observational bridges to yoswc_loyalty_* with original arguments; never bind both observer channels as economic producers.
compatibility.persistence: Keep balances/history IDs/options/order markers/session identifiers until the admitted LOYF-6 migration; no synthetic historical event identities.
compatibility.edition_load: Free bootstrap must refuse simultaneous canonical internals with active Premium before includes; no duplicate declarations or two economic engines.
compatibility.domain: Only WP translation domain arguments change; identifiers, paths, stored owner IDs, event keys and integration strings remain byte-equivalent.
